observations: Single automotive headlight/headlamp assembly shown on a plain background.
Lamp appears clear-lensed with amber turn-signal section, consistent with a mid-2010s sedan style headlight.
Watermark text overlaid on the image reads 'HONDA AND ACURA POSTED ON...' but this is a seller-added watermark, not a label or part number printed on the physical part.
No visible OEM part number, connector detail, or model-specific marking on the housing itself.
No photos of bulbs, wiring harness, back of housing, or any cracks/fog inside the lens.

read_from: photo 0 (watermark only, not a part marking)

claims.claim: Body, engine and suspension parts for all model of Honda, Acura and Toyota cars and SUVs
claims.evidence: Only one headlight is shown; no inventory, no other parts, no proof of range across models or brands.
Watermark is seller-applied text, not a photo of a part number, badge, or fitment sticker on the item.

risks.risk: Exact make/model/year fitment unknown, which drives price heavily for headlights
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any molded part number or OEM sticker on the back of the housing, or a photo showing the connector plug shape
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at all without this; fitment-dependent parts need a model to select a comparable

risks.risk: Internal condition (cracked lens, moisture fogging, broken tabs, missing bulbs/ballast)
risks.proof: Photos of the rear housing, connector, and a lit-up test clip
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional/damaged until shown working

risks.risk: Whether this is OEM or aftermarket reproduction
risks.proof: Close-up of any manufacturer logo or stamped part number on the lens or housing
risks.if_unproven: priced as aftermarket/generic, the lower-value assumption

risks.risk: Completeness of the part (bulbs, adjusters, wiring pigtail included or not)
risks.proof: Full-item photo including back and underside showing all connectors and sockets

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the part number or OEM sticker on the rear of the headlight housing
Photo of the connector/plug area to help identify the vehicle model
Photo or short clip of the headlight powered on to show both low and high beam working
Photo of the rear housing and any cracks, fog, or moisture inside the lens
Wider photo of the full stock of parts mentioned (engine, suspension items) if buyer wants those too
response.reason: The single photo shows a generic headlight assembly with no readable model, part number, or fitment marking, so the vehicle model that determines its value cannot be set even at a worst-case price; a close-up of the part number or connector is needed first.
